notes.title: UPDATE 0.96 - You Can Now Save & Load Your Games!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43168682/356f23514f43d111989ea9edf2025df6eb90887f.png[/img]

Massive Update for CyberBrick!!

...You not longer have to devote potentially "hours" of your time to completing a game in a single sitting!

With this update, you now have the ability to SAVE YOUR PROGRESS at any point in the game!

* To save your game progress, simply hit the ESC key on your keyboard and hit the "S" button to save your progress.  The game will save your game and return you to the introduction screen where you are free to exit the game and pick up your saved game at a more convenient time.

Some notes about saving your game:

- The game will save your score, your current level, your current money balance, your current number of balls remaining, and your current paddle health.  As of right now, the game will NOT save any progress you have on the level as far as bricks destroyed in that level when you save.  I might update this in the future to also save bricks destroyed but for right now, this serves as a sort of "cost" to save your progress.  

- SAVING YOUR GAME AT THE BEGINNING OF A NEW LEVEL IS ADVISED SO THAT YOU DON'T LOSE ANY PROGRESS WHENEVER YOU WANT TO SAVE A GAME AND PICK IT UP LATER.

- Once a game is saved, you can always load that saved game from the introduction screen by pressing the 'L' key on your keyboard.  (A note will be displayed at the bottom of the introduction screen if you have a saved game ready to load)

- Once you load a saved game, that saved file is deleted.  This is to prevent a player from saving a game say at level 25 with a million points, and then being able to repeatedly load that same progress back over and over again.  So make sure you are "ready" to play whenever you load a saved game!

- You can only ever have ONE save file per each Steam account.  What this means is that if you have a game saved, and you launch a brand new game and then save that game, your new save file will over-write your previous save file.  Be careful with this because let's imagine you achieve level 30 and have 300,000 points and save your game at that point.  If you come back later and only get to level 2 with 10,000 points and then save that game, your previous save file with 300k points at level 30 will be over-written with your new level 2 & 10k point save.  You'd be much better off loading your 300k & level 30 save file and then playing a little and re-saving that game if you only have a little time to play.

- The save files are located on your own personal device, but they are encrypted with 128 bit data structuring to prevent players from simply changing values on their save files to "cheat" high scores and other values.  While you won't be able to read or alter these text files to "cheat", you may want to back up a game save file if you are changing devices or reinstalling Windows on your device before playing CyberBrick again.


That's pretty much it for this update.  Oh, a brand new level has also been added as the starting level of every new game, but that's it for this update as I get closer to bringing "CyberBrick" to it's version 1.0 release.

Be sure and comment below and let me know how you like this update and of course if you experience any bugs or problems with saving and loading your games!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.87 - Bricks Shake & Fall Now! - Thunder Ball With Lightning Power!
notes.content:
Update 0.87 is my continued support and show of love for CyberBrick!

In this update, I made things a little trickier by making bricks that are on their last stage before breaking eventually quiver, shake, and fall if left sitting unbroken for too long.  The best way to prevent falling bricks is to get really good at completely breaking them in their original position!

Getting hit by falling bricks will reduce your health unless you have the perk of paddle invincibility found on the purchasable perk window before each level that was added in the previous update 0.86.

Remember that if you take too much damage and your paddle gets broken due to low health, your game is immediately over regardless of how many balls you might have remaining.  Collecting repair wrenches that fall occasionally from shattered bricks can help restore your health.  Also clearing your current level of bricks also will restore your paddle health to 100%.

Also in this update, I added the purchasable perk called "Thunder Strike" that means all balls for that level will spark with electricity which can help zap and clear the bricks much quicker!


More content is planned and coming for CyberBrick. and more updates will continue to come for this game!


Have a great weekend!


Sincerely, 

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.86 - Purchasable Level Perks Are Live! .. Cleaner UI Is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43168682/6f3777788a3d94f478b145d8379ef3658c7c5c5c.png[/img]

This is a pretty big update and it is definitely a game changer for CyberBrick!

Now, there are 15 purchasable perks in the game that you can spend your in game money on to give you all sorts of advantages as you play the game!

Before every single level now, you'll see two perks roll like a slot machine and you'll be given information and a cost for each perk!  You can also always choose to Re-roll the perks if you don't like them for a cost of $15 in game dollars.  ..Or if you just want to play without spending any money at all, simply hit the "Let's Play" button at any time!  - You can even hit the "Let's Play" button before the perks stop spinning to skip it all together and immediately move on.

Remember that all of the perks are only good for a single level and nothing is permanent.. except that cost that you pay for the perks you buy!

Other changes in this update:

- A cleaner overall UI has been made to space everything out better.  All of the game options such as changing the background or changing the game volume can still be adjusted at any time during the game with the same keys.  To see the options and the keys use to change all of the settings, simply hit the right mouse button or the escape key to pause the game.

- Playing your own level in the level editor will now only net you $1 at a time for collecting the money drops regardless of what brick dropped the money.  This is to encourage earning money by playing the real game levels over simply making "phat loot" levels in the level editor to try and amass easy money outside of a real game.

- Many of the sound effects have been balanced to not be too loud or too low in contrast to the music and other game sounds.

- The default volume of the game has been changed from 50% to 15%.


I hope that you enjoy the new update and all the cool new "goodies" you can spend your in-game money on to help you score more points and see higher score totals!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... ( Solo Indie Game Developer)

With this update, I added 5 new buttons to give you much more precise control on exactly where your bricks are placed in the levels you design!  Full Width, Half Width, Quarter Width, Full Height, and Half Height will now do exactly as they say, move your brick tool at those exact portions of the brick dimensions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43168682/fadb5ddbf47ff3040e0b77d280436a622de7d04b.png[/img]

I also added the ability to press the F8 key while in the level editor to turn on and off some section lines on the borders of the build area to better help you keep your bricks lined up where you want them.

I look forward to seeing what you players design as playable levels for this game! notes.title: UPDATE 0.83 - CyberBrick Now Has a Working Level Designer!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I've been hard at work, while working full time at my real job making my first ever level designer!  This is a new milestone for me and ground I've never traveled until making this level crafting tool for this game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43168682/5c7209461b005a34660373d2fe601c74031c1905.png[/img]

I can say with full certainty that I should have made something like this years ago because this level designers I've made over the last few days is at least 50 times better, easier, and faster than the level design tools that come standard with the GameMaker software that I use!  

If you enjoy designing levels and even seeing what you make become a part of a game that everyone might enjoy when they play CyberBrick for years to come.. then this might be right up your alley!

If you'd like to show off your level designs, I've made a channel just for this on my Discord channel that you can join and see right here:
https://discord.gg/HN3CfNTr58

When you make a level in CyberBrick, you can play it to test it out and even see how many points you can score playing it, just like if it was already a part of the game!  You can also save your level by clicking the SAVE button at any time on the bottom right corner.  If you want to play or work on a level that you've previously saved, simply click the LOAD button and be sure you type in the same name you saved it as!  

..If you have forgotten your level names or just want to browse, delete, or even copy your levels to share with friends, simply go to the level save folder on your computer.  The location for CyberBricks level saves is C: drive/Users/Your default folder/AppData/Local/CyberBrick/Level_Saves

This level designer will only get better as I have more time to work on it.. I plan on adding the ability to be more precise with exactly where you line up each brick and I've already added 9 new brick colors to the default 4 bricks I have been making the levels in the game with for months!  ..So yes, you have a much more powerful and easy to use level designer than what I've been using for years with the level designer that I've made for this game!

I also have a lot more planned for CyberBrick including lots of new content!  While I work on that, you can help me make the game even better by designing and sharing your best level designs!

If you'd like for your levels to be considered for permanent addition to my game so that everyone can play it, you'll be given full credit every time your level pops up on someones game!  Just let me know what user name to credit in the game!  I hold the rights to refuse any level design entries and/or usernames form good taste!  


I hope that you are enjoying your summer and any level making you might be doing with CyberBrick!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)
